tasks.label: flutter: flutter build apk
tasks.command: flutter build apk --release && VERSION_LINE=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml) && VERSION_NAME=$(echo "$VERSION_LINE" | sed -E 's/^version:[[:space:]]*([^+[:space:]]+).*/\1/') && VERSION_CODE=$(echo "$VERSION_LINE" | sed -E 's/.*\+([0-9]+).*/\1/') && SRC='build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk' && DEST="$HOME/Desktop/Sandoghcheh-${VERSION_NAME}-${VERSION_CODE}.apk" && cp "$SRC" "$DEST" && echo "Release APK → $DEST" && APKSIGNER=$(ls -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools/"*/apksigner 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1) && "$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$DEST"
